<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <meta name="color-scheme" content="light dark">
  <meta name="description" content="">
  <title>Untitled</title>
  <link rel="icon" href="data:,">
  <style>
    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
    html { -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; text-size-adjust: 100%; }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { html { scroll-behavior: smooth; } }
    hr { border: 0; border-top: 1px solid; opacity: 0.25; }
    abbr[title] { text-decoration: underline dotted; cursor: help; }
    table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; }
    caption { text-align: start; font-weight: 600; }
    :target { scroll-margin-block: 1rem; }
    body {
      min-height: 100vh;
      min-height: 100svh;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
      margin: 0 auto;
      max-width: 65ch;
      padding: 1rem;
      font-family: system-ui, sans-serif;
      line-height: 1.5;
    }
    input, button, textarea, select { font: inherit; }
    h1, h2, h3 { line-height: 1.2; text-wrap: balance; }
    p { text-wrap: pretty; }
    p, li, h1, h2, h3 { overflow-wrap: break-word; }
    img, svg, video, canvas, picture { max-width: 100%; display: block; }
    img, video { height: auto; }
    pre, code, kbd, samp { font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; }
    pre { overflow-x: auto; tab-size: 2; }
    th, td { padding: 0.25em 0.5em; text-align: start; vertical-align: top; }
    sub, sup { line-height: 0; }
    a { text-underline-offset: 0.15em; }
    button:not(:disabled), [role="button"], summary, label[for] { cursor: pointer; }
    textarea { resize: vertical; }
    [hidden] { display: none !important; }
    :focus-visible { outline: 2px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 2px; }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      *, *::before, *::after { animation-duration: 0.01ms !important; animation-iteration-count: 1 !important; transition-duration: 0.01ms !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important; }
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <main>
  </main>
</body>
</html>

content.text:
I made some small fixes to `0.html`. It's an empty boilerplate page, so I only tightened up its base styles and head tags. I haven't opened it in a browser to check. My first try used a shell script, but the session doesn't allow commands that need approval, so it was blocked. I made the same changes with direct file edits instead.

**Changes:**
- **Removed the empty `<meta name="description">`.** An empty description is worse than having none, because search engines may show a blank snippet. Add it back once there's real text for it.
- **Changed `100svh` to `100dvh`.** The body's minimum height now follows the mobile browser's toolbar as it shows and hides, so it matches the space actually on screen. The `100vh` fallback is still there.
- **Removed `-webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased`.** It only works on macOS and makes text thinner, which can hurt readability.
- **Form controls now use the page's text color** (`color: inherit`), so buttons and inputs follow light/dark mode instead of keeping the browser's default colors.
- **Heading styles now cover `h4`–`h6`**, and long words also wrap inside `figcaption` and `blockquote`.
- **`iframe` now has the same `max-width: 100%` as images**, so embedded content can't make the page scroll sideways.
- **Tables:** header cells get a faint bottom border, and numbers in data cells line up in columns.

The page still has the title "Untitled" and an empty `<main>`. If you tell me what the page is for, I can fill in the content and set a real title and description.
